domPurify.use: browser baseline sanitizer oracle only; absent from production

nativeArchitecture.valueType: MonaMarkdownString is a value type with raw-UTF16 value, explicit trust, theme-icon bit, optional base MonaURI and a mutable href-to-MonaURI map; supportHtml is absent.
nativeArchitecture.parser: A repository-vendored Swift port of the pinned Marked 14.0.0 synchronous default grammar produces an immutable semantic document; no JavaScript engine, DOM, WebView or HTML string becomes production truth.
nativeArchitecture.parserDefaults: async=false, breaks=false, GFM=true, pedantic=false, silent=false and no extensions/hooks/custom tokenizer/walkTokens.
nativeArchitecture.sanitizer: The native semantic builder admits only typed Markdown nodes, applies the pinned link/trust/baseUri/uris rules before creating controls and never parses a post-render HTML string.
nativeArchitecture.layout: Text, code, lists, tables, quotes, headings, separators, task checkboxes, links and safe trusted spans map to native attributed runs and AppKit controls that feed Core Text geometry and A2 accessibility contracts.
nativeArchitecture.codeBlocks: The first language-info token is resolved through the retained language registry; a registered token provider colors the block, otherwise plaintext is rendered with editor font; async completion obeys the validity gate.
nativeArchitecture.themeIcons: supportThemeIcons retains Monaco icon escaping and substitution against the T1-R icon registry.
nativeArchitecture.links: Non-command activation is a user gesture routed through MonaLinkOpener; trust-admitted command activation is routed through the component command registry and then the existing MonaCommandHost fallback; no link calls NSWorkspace, filesystem or network implicitly.
nativeArchitecture.lifetime: Every parse, tokenize and layout result is owned by the widget generation and discarded after model/provider/theme/localization change, cancellation or widget disposal.

trustContract.untrusted: command links are removed; all other admitted schemes remain inert until user activation and host opener handling.
trustContract.allCommands: isTrusted=true admits command links; activation decodes the command URI query using the pinned URI/JSON argument rules and invokes the normal component-command then host-command route.
trustContract.selectedCommands: enabledCommands preserves the exact array in the value type; every command link remains visible, but activation of an ID absent from the array is consumed without execution, while membership invokes the normal command route.
trustContract.rawHtmlDefault: supportHtml is absent and treated as false; ordinary raw HTML tokens follow Monaco's supportHtml=false behavior.
trustContract.trustedSpanException: The existing supportHtml=false trusted single-span exception is retained only for span open/close tokens whose class or style passes the exact Monaco predicates; it maps to native attributes and never creates arbitrary elements.
trustContract.componentSideEffects: Parsing, layout and hover display perform no filesystem, process, socket, URLSession, NSWorkspace or WebView operation.

supportHtml.effect: The public Swift mapping has no supportHtml member; full raw-HTML rendering and the 67-entry browser tag allowlist are absent.

media.effect: Markdown images and all HTML media fetching/playback are absent; image syntax contributes its parsed alt text only and never reads data, file, HTTP or host bytes.

webRuntime.effect: DOM nodes, HTML serialization, DOMPurify, Trusted Types, browser drag behavior and browser URL loading are absent; semantic tree, native controls and opener routing replace them.

internalAlertSyntax.effect: supportAlertSyntax is not in the public IMarkdownString surface and has no true assignment in the fixed standalone source graph.

acceptance.C04: Both declaration paths and six retained input members exist; supportHtml is absent; all 11 consumer declaration fields reach the same native pipeline.
acceptance.C05: Every retained widget preserves semantic node order, focus, selection, copy, scroll, resize, theme, code-block update and disposal behavior.
acceptance.C06: Provider/LSP Markdown values preserve raw UTF-16, trust, theme icon, baseUri, URI map, cancellation, stale-result and code-tokenization behavior.
acceptance.C07: Visible text, links, headings, lists, tables, task states, code and alt text produce native labels, roles, children, actions and announcements from the same semantic tree.
acceptance.C10: The distribution manifest proves the supportHtml/media cuts, absence of JS/DOM/WebView/DOMPurify, the vendored Marked MIT notice and exact generated parser tables/source hashes.
acceptance.P11: Adds 0, 1, 1000 and 10000 provider Markdown results plus 100000/100001-UTF16 boundary, GFM tables/lists/code, trust/link/baseUri/URI-map/theme-icon and cancellation cases to both-baseline provider/UI-present cells.
acceptance.differential: For every retained case, compare token/semantic tree, raw visible UTF-16, plaintext projection, link target and allow-command disposition, code-block language/value, theme-icon identity, focus/action trace and AX tree; native geometry remains the V1 native domain.
acceptance.security: Malformed Markdown, hostile links, raw HTML, encoded schemes, command allowlists, URI maps, nested inputs, oversized values and disposal races execute with zero implicit external side effects.

licenseContract.monaco: MIT notice retained for copied or adapted Monaco renderer/value behavior.
licenseContract.marked: The Swift source port retains the MarkedJS MIT copyright and license notice and marks modified files.
licenseContract.domPurify: DOMPurify 3.4.8 is an oracle-only comparator component and is absent from production; copying or deriving its code requires a new provenance revision and Apache-2.0 or MPL-2.0 compliance.
licenseContract.comparatorBundle: A redistributed Monaco comparator bundle includes its pinned ThirdPartyNotices and all component notices.
